metaDesc: SYLY answers a learner's question from the course itself, in Amharic, English or Arabic, shows the source, reads it aloud and always offers a real person.
h1: An accessible, multilingual assistant for every course page
lead: SYLY answers a learner's question from the course itself, in Amharic, English or Arabic, shows where the answer came from, reads it aloud, and always offers a real person.
forSub: Built first for learners who are too often left out.
for1p: Questions and answers in Amharic, with pre-recorded Amharic audio that works even on a phone with no Amharic voice.
for2p: Made for keyboard, TalkBack and NVDA, 200% zoom and 320 px width. The answer is announced without the learner moving.
for3p: One small script with no dependencies. It works on a slow connection, and answers already loaded work offline.
levelsH: Three ways to plug it in
levelsSub: Start with two lines. Add a server only when you need more.
lv1p: A script tag and a db-assistant tag. Answers come from your course text, in the browser.
lv2p: Adds AI answers (only if the learner allows them), a person to talk to, text messages and a Telegram bot.
lv3p: Marks up job posts with schema.org JobPosting, including the accommodations an employer offers.
how1: A learner asks a question, by typing or speaking. SYLY finds the matching part of your course.
how2: If the learner allows it, an AI service only puts those words into a clear sentence. It may not add anything the course does not say.
how3: Every answer links to the lesson section it came from.
how4: If nothing matches, SYLY says so and offers a real person with one button. It never guesses.
demoH: Try it: ask SYLY about SYLY
demoP: This is the real assistant, answering from a short page about SYLY. Try: What is SYLY? How does it work? Is my data private?
devP: Create a free developer account with Google, add your site, and get the code to paste. Learners never sign in.
teamP: Team SYLY (Lemi, Saron, Yabets, Yamlak) built SYLY for Track 3 of the Digital Bridge Accessibility Hackathon, ALX. The licence is to be confirmed. Everything on this site uses test data only.
